title: GPU remove_redundant_reorders clang-tidy braces-around-statements errors
signature: clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements error if statement missing braces treated as warning as error|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build-gpu / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build with clang-tidy enabled failed: 2 clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements errors treated as warnings-as-errors in remove_redundant_reorders.cpp

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_clang_tidy
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status check failed because the Build-gpu clang-tidy job failed

key_errors:
remove_redundant_reorders.cpp:156:86: error: statement should be inside braces [readability-braces-around-statements,-warnings-as-errors]
  156 |                     if (!usr->is_type<reorder>() || &usr->get_dependency(0) != &node)
      |                                                                                      ^
  157 |                         continue;
2 warnings treated as errors; ninja: build stopped: cannot make progress due to previous errors.
root_cause: PR #38641 adds new code to remove_redundant_reorders.cpp (pinning the output_format of a reorder's downstream user before the reorder node is removed) using single-statement if bodies without braces: `if (!usr->is_type<reorder>() || &usr->get_dependency(0) != &node) continue;` and `if (usr_prim->output_format == format::any) usr_prim->output_format = output_layout.format;`. The repository's clang-tidy configuration enables readability-braces-around-statements and treats clang-tidy warnings as errors on the clang-tidy build variant, so these unbraced single-line if bodies fail the dedicated 'Cmake build with clang-tidy enabled' step, which in turn fails the aggregate ci/gha_overall_status_clang_tidy check. The regular (non-clang-tidy) build variants are unaffected because they don't run clang-tidy.
reproduction_steps: Run clang-tidy locally against the changed file with the repo's .clang-tidy config, e.g.: `clang-tidy-18 --config-file=.clang-tidy src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/remove_redundant_reorders.cpp -- <same compile flags as in CI, see job-134604877382.log>` or simply build with `-DENABLE_CLANG_TIDY=ON` locally to reproduce the two readability-braces-around-statements errors at lines 158 and 161 of the PR's version of the file.
recommended_actions: Add braces around both single-statement if bodies in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/remove_redundant_reorders.cpp: `if (!usr->is_type<reorder>() || &usr->get_dependency(0) != &node) { continue; }` and `if (usr_prim->output_format == format::any) { usr_prim->output_format = output_layout.format; }`
Re-run clang-tidy locally (or push and watch the clang-tidy CI job) before re-adding the PR to the merge queue
Consider running clang-tidy as a pre-commit/local check on new GPU graph-optimizer code to catch this class of issue before CI
prevention_strategies: Always brace single-statement if/for/while bodies in new code touching src/plugins/intel_gpu (and any other component built with -DENABLE_CLANG_TIDY=ON), matching the project's clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements rule. Run the project's .clang-format/clang-tidy checks locally before pushing, especially for files under directories covered by the clang-tidy CI build variant.
historical_context: No prior merge-queue investigation matches this exact clang-tidy braces-around-statements signature. Related but distinct past patterns: a RISC-V clang-tidy build artifact-upload 403 Infrastructure issue (pattern 602c52a223d7ebfe) and an unrelated ARM64 CPU functional test flakiness pattern (a73572e761729ca3) that also surfaced alongside a GPU clang-tidy PR. This is the first recorded occurrence of a missing-braces clang-tidy failure in this component.
